The main takeaway from our work is that

the contribution of P-gp or Bcrp to net efflux at both the BBB and BTBs is larger than that expected from their relative expression levels, which is consistent with the notion that the expression of P-gp is up-regulated in the absence of Bcrp.
P-gp and/or Bcrp should be considered when evaluating the brain and testis penetration of a new drug.
